This small plot is my rice field in the fadama, where water gathers in the season. Rice needs plenty of food to grow well, so I will buy fertilizer — usually one bag of urea and one bag of NPK if I can manage it. I save my own seed from last year since the agro-dealer is far and improved seed costs too much. I will spray herbicide to save me from endless weeding, and my wife and I will do most of the work ourselves, but I must hire a few hands for transplanting and harvest because rice work comes all at once.
